currentRoundInspection.scope: Three actually inspected2008/2013 exterior/entrance pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys,exact-QID OSM reclassification or redistributed photographs;current finish unverified.

pictures.author: Andrew Shiva /Wikipedia /Godot13
pictures.observed: Inspected enlarged southeast exterior:gold sheet dome with panel rhythm/finial above patterned blue-green drum;octagonal pale marble lower walls and blue/turquoise/cream upper tilework. Upper wall has repeated round-arched glazed and blind panels below broad blue/white patterned parapet bands. Broad south porch has stone columns and a curved blue-tile canopy;east side doorway has two columns and an arched decorated tympanum. Separate Dome of the Chain visible at right remains host content. Gold and blue are identity colors;fine inscriptions/patterns are not copied or invented.

pictures.author: Andrew Shiva /Wikipedia /Godot13
pictures.observed: Inspected complete cropped southern upper facade/dome view:bulging gold cap with rectangular sheet joints,small orb/ring finial,patterned circular drum,broad blue parapet/cream patterned border bands and arched window/portal tympanum rhythm. This picture crops off lower walls and porch base;it is not used as evidence for unseen bases. Exact calligraphy,geometric ceramic motifs and construction detail abstracted into shared mosaic/tint bands.

pictures.author: Andrew Shiva /Wikipedia /Godot13
pictures.observed: Inspected full side entrance detail:closed bronze-brown decorated double door between pale jambs,paired pinkish marble columns on squared bases,carved pale capitals/straight lintel and rising blue/cream arched tympanum. Lower marble has horizontal panel courses. Columns,capitals,door and color bands guide simplified geometry;fine carving,stud patterns/calligraphy and hidden entrance plan are not asserted. Side bearing is not independently established by this close-up.
